name: Faire
summary: Faire operates a wholesale marketplace connecting independent retailers with brands, using software and financing to modernize local retail purchasing.
overview: Faire is a wholesale marketplace for independent retailers and brands. It combines product discovery, ordering, payment terms, and software intended to make local retail purchasing more efficient.
bull_case: A scaled wholesale network can compound through retailer demand, brand supply, transaction data, and embedded financial services.
bear_case: Wholesale demand is cyclical, and a large marketplace must maintain liquidity and disciplined unit economics across many small merchants.
latest_round: November 2021: $400M Series G at a reported $12.4B valuation
directory_notes: Independent retailer activity and repeat ordering.
Marketplace liquidity, payment terms, and contribution margins.

intelligence.description: Faire operates a digital wholesale marketplace for independent retailers and brands, combining discovery, ordering, payment terms, and merchant tools.
company: Faire connects independent retailers with brands through a wholesale marketplace designed to replace manual product discovery and ordering. The platform also offers payment terms and software, making its commercial model broader than a simple product catalogue.

The company announced a $400 million Series G in November 2021 at a $12.4 billion valuation. Its long-term thesis is that small retailers can gain a more efficient buying workflow while brands receive a scalable distribution channel outside traditional trade-show and sales-representative models.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Faire is a useful private-market test of whether vertical marketplaces can become durable commerce infrastructure. Its results reflect the health of independent retail, merchant software adoption, and the economics of extending credit around marketplace transactions.

changed.text: Faire is founded to modernize wholesale purchasing for independent retailers.
A Series F round values the company at $7B.
The company announces $400M of Series G funding at a $12.4B valuation.

takeaways: Faire needs both retailer demand and brand supply to remain liquid across categories.
Payment terms can strengthen retention but introduce credit and balance-sheet considerations.
Its reported valuation was set in 2021, so it should not be treated as a live market price.
The core question is whether software and transaction services deepen the marketplace's defensibility.
